title: Patience that ripens into honor
subtitle: For waiting that needs more than endurance
description: These readings move waiting from frustration into saintly company, mercy, Naam, and the quiet honor of listening well.

heroSource.shortMeaning: True wealth, patience, and honor ripen as the wandering mind settles in sangat and Naam.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let waiting become a place of listening instead of a room for complaint.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey teaches patience as a fruit of better company and truer wealth.
evidence.turn: Waiting changes when the heart trades hurry for Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: Use the delay to listen, serve, or remember rather than to rehearse frustration.
